signal: Daxko declared a company-wide AI-first strategy with a phased rollout starting Q1 2026 and was named to Athletech News' Most Innovative Fitness Companies of 2026.

email.body1:
Celeste, saw Daxko declared an AI-first strategy with a phased rollout this year and made Athletech's Most Innovative list for 2026.

A platform shift that visible usually puts more accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Daxko off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Celeste, quick follow-up for Daxko.

An AI-first story fills the funnel, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Celeste, last bit of proof for Daxko.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Daxko's reply rate likely compares to other fitness software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Celeste, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out an AI-first strategy is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fitness software motion? I'll tailor it to Daxko either way.
